title: frame
description: One motion frame as worlds see it. Emitted by the hub on Socket.IO namespace /viewer, event 'frame', exactly once per valid pose_frame received on /ingest, and posted unchanged by the bridge to the world as { type: 'frame', frame }. The hub adds the derived motion fields (velocities, angular velocity, abs_vel, norm_abs_vel) to each body and stamps 'timestamp'. A frame never carries audio: audio is its own stream (audio.schema.json). This file also defines the role enum and the pose fields that pose_frame.schema.json references.

schemaVersion.description: Contract version. Consumers must reject any other value.

timestamp.description: Hub receipt time of the pose_frame this frame was derived from, Unix epoch milliseconds (JS Date.now()). The minimum rejects a value accidentally sent in seconds.

bodies.description: Tracked bodies keyed by role, so each role occurs at most once. A missing role means that body is not tracked in this frame. May be empty.

role.description: What a tracked body is on the performer (or which object it is). Closed set: adding a role is a contract version bump. Sources map their own identifiers to these (OptiTrack: tracking.roles in config/cobeart.yaml, Motive streaming ID to role).

poseFields.$comment: Shared by pose_frame.schema.json (closed as is) and body below (extended with the derived motion fields). No additionalProperties here, so both can extend it; each closes it with unevaluatedProperties.
poseFields.description: Pose of one body in arena coordinates. Arena axes (D5): right-handed, x and y horizontal, z vertical (up), origin at arena centre on the floor. Positions are millimetres; nominal arena bounds come from arena in config/cobeart.yaml (x and y in [-3000, 3000], z in [0, 2500]) and are not enforced here, because a body slightly outside the arena is a valid observation that consumers clamp. Orientation (D5, provisional pending an on-site check) is a unit quaternion in arena axes, not Euler angles, so it has no gimbal lock or wraparound. At identity the body faces arena +y with up = +z (body right = +x). Consumers derive what they need from it, e.g. forward = q applied to (0, 1, 0), and forward lean = asin(-forward.z), positive leaning forward.

x.description: Position along arena x, integer millimetres. Nominal range [-3000, 3000].

y.description: Position along arena y, integer millimetres. Nominal range [-3000, 3000].

z.description: Height above the arena floor (arena z, up), integer millimetres. Nominal range [0, 2500].

qx.description: Orientation quaternion, x component (vector part). The quaternion (qx, qy, qz, qw) is unit length and maps body axes to arena axes as a proper rotation. q and -q are the same orientation: consumers must not rely on the sign.

qy.description: Orientation quaternion, y component (vector part). The quaternion (qx, qy, qz, qw) is unit length and maps body axes to arena axes as a proper rotation. q and -q are the same orientation: consumers must not rely on the sign.

qz.description: Orientation quaternion, z component (vector part). The quaternion (qx, qy, qz, qw) is unit length and maps body axes to arena axes as a proper rotation. q and -q are the same orientation: consumers must not rely on the sign.

qw.description: Orientation quaternion, scalar part (scalar-last order, as in scipy and THREE.js).

body.description: One body in a frame: its pose plus the motion values the hub derives per role from successive pose_frames, using pose_frame.source_time_s as the clock (not receipt time). A role's motion state restarts, reporting 0 for every derived field, on its first sighting, after a gap in source time above metrics.max_gap_s (config/cobeart.yaml), or when the source clock goes backwards.

vx.description: Velocity along arena x, mm/s (finite difference between successive poses of this role over source time).

wx.description: Angular velocity about arena x, degrees/s. The vector (wx, wy, wz) is computed from successive orientation quaternions (rotation vector of q_now * q_prev^-1 over the time step), in arena axes, so it has no spikes at angle wraparound.

wy.description: Angular velocity about arena y, degrees/s. The vector (wx, wy, wz) is computed from successive orientation quaternions (rotation vector of q_now * q_prev^-1 over the time step), in arena axes, so it has no spikes at angle wraparound.

wz.description: Angular velocity about arena z, degrees/s. The vector (wx, wy, wz) is computed from successive orientation quaternions (rotation vector of q_now * q_prev^-1 over the time step), in arena axes, so it has no spikes at angle wraparound.

abs_vel.description: Horizontal speed sqrt(vx^2 + vy^2), mm/s. vz is not included.

norm_abs_vel.description: abs_vel divided by metrics.max_vel (13000 mm/s) and capped at 1, then held at the maximum of the last metrics.history_window values so it decays only after sustained stillness. Dimensionless, [0, 1].
